514:t_10:9.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「It may be anger, but right now, he's honestly letting out what's in his heart.」

514:t_10:10.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「I'm sure once he's let it all out, he'll be able to smile like he used to.」

514:t_10:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...I understand, $$マリーダ$$. If you're that determined, I, $$ＡＧ$$, will stand by you to the very end.」

514:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'll add the 100 Z worth of $$Ｚチップ$$s he produced this time to the team's stock.」

514:t_10:13.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「The $$バンシィ$$ is gradually adapting to him... Our next encounter will surely be our final battle with him.」

514:t_10:15.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「I'll try. After all, I'm a member of $c, too.」

514:t_10:22.en:
$$アスラン$$
「So this robot is the $$ＡＧ$$ that $$キラ$$ told me about.」

514:t_10:23.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A... $$アスラン$$... When you stare at me like that...」

514:t_10:24.en:
$$アスラン$$
「Sorry. I like tinkering with machines, so autonomous robots interest me.」

514:t_10:25.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's a shame I'm not a pretty girl model like $$ノノ$$, $$モーム$$, or $$ドロシー#bigo$$.」

514:t_10:27.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh, come now... You're famous as a dangerous ladies' man, $$アスラン$$.」

514:t_10:28.en:
$$アスラン$$
「$$キラ$$! Did you tell him that!?」

514:t_10:32.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now, now, $$アスラン$$. Gathering information is something of an essential skill for a dimensional merchant.」

514:t_10:33.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「For now, let's perform the ceremony to induct you into $c.」

514:t_10:34.en:
$$アスラン$$
「I appreciate the offer, but I'll pass. I'm not in the mood.」

514:t_10:35.en:
$$キラ$$
「So being called dangerous really did bother you.」

514:t_10:39.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「I have no intention of letting some shady robot sweet-talk me.」

514:t_10:40.en:
$$シン$$
「There you have it, $$ＡＧ$$. $$レイ#pt136$$ is a tough customer.」

514:t_10:41.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$アスラン$$, $$レイ#pt136$$... I... will never give up.」

514:t_10:42.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then I'll go solo today, for the first time in a while! Once again, let's get fired up... Business, business!」

514:t_10:43.en:
$n
「I wonder where that obsession of yours comes from...」

515:t_001:0.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「All right! We've plunged right into the heart of $$プラント$$!」

515:t_001:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「It's too soon to celebrate, $$ラッセ$$. The real operation starts now.」

515:t_001:2.en:
$$フェルト$$
「The $$ラー・カイラム$$ and $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ are drawing $$ザフト$$'s attention at the first defense line.」

515:t_001:3.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「The $$プラント$$ defense forces have emerged!」

515:t_002:0.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「We don't need to deploy the mobile units. Keep pretending we're just probing their defenses and focus on drawing the enemy's attention.」

515:t_002:1.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「I understand. This is my chance to show my skills!」

515:t_002:2.en:
$$フェルト$$
「The infiltration team has reached $$アプリリウス$$ City.」

515:t_002:3.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(Hurry, $$シン$$. You and your friend may decide the outcome of this battle...)

515:t_003:0.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「This is bad, $$スメラギ$$! We're nearly at our limit!」

515:t_003:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「I'll deploy the mobile units at the last possible moment! Hold out until then!」

515:t_004:0.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Has the $$ラー・カイラム$$ come to help!?」

515:t_005:1.en:
$$フェルト$$
「The $$ジェニオン$$ is coming!」

515:t_006:0.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「We've recovered $l and the infiltration team! $$ヤマト#kira$$ and $$アスカ#shinn$$ are reportedly still in $$アプリリウス$$!」

515:t_006:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「I'll leave them to $$ルナマリア$$! Launch the mobile units!」

515:t_007:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$バナージ$$, $c... I'll deal with you later.」

515:t_007:2.en:
$$リディ$$
「All units, begin the attack! Our target is $$アプリリウス$$, home to $$プラント$$'s capital!」

515:t_007:4.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「So the $$クロノ$$ Conservatives are targeting $$プラント$$, $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s ally!」

515:t_007:5.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Even so, civilians live there, too!」

515:t_007:6.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Have you forgotten that $$クロノ$$ ordered the oppression of the $$スペースノイド$$s?」

515:t_007:7.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Damn it! They're attacking $$プラント$$ to make an example of it, too!?」

515:t_007:8.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I can't believe Ensign $$リディ$$ would take part in an operation like this!」

515:t_007:9.en:
$$リディ$$
「This is part of my duty, too.」

515:t_007:10.en:
$$グラハム$$
「You've fallen far, $$リディ・マーセナス$$!」

515:t_007:11.en:
$$刹那$$
「Have you completely lost sight of what you're fighting for!?」

515:t_007:12.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「All units, target Ensign $$リディ$$! We'll stop their commander and protect $$プラント$$!」

515:t_008:1.en:
$$五飛$$
「We'll take down the enemies approaching $$プラント$$ first!」

515:t_008:2.en:
$$リディ$$
「You're going to protect your own enemies, $c?」

515:t_008:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Please remember, Ensign $$リディ$$! We fought for the world, regardless of the $$地球連邦$$ or the colonies!」

515:t_008:5.en:
$$リディ$$
「I already told you, $$バナージ$$. If you claim it's for the world, do as I say.」

515:t_008:6.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Tch! Can we really not get through to him at all anymore!?」

515:t_008:7.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「We have no choice but to stop him by force...!」

515:t_008:8.en:
$n
「Please be careful... It seems the $$クロノ$$ Reformists are here, too.」

515:t_008:10.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Is $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ going to intervene in this battle?」

515:t_008:12.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Since we can't read that man's intentions, we can't be too careful.」

515:t_008:13.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「All units, intercept the Conservatives while watching out for the Reformists!」

515:t_008:14.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Heh... That's what I expect from you, $c.」

515:t_008:15.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$...! I will stop you!」
